Strengths are qualities and practices you can draw on while working toward change.

- Determination
- Commitment
- Discipline
- Hopefulness
- Honesty
- Kindness
- Open-Minded
- Self-Awareness
- Motivation
- Courage
- Confidence
- Focus
- Flexibility
- Forgiveness (self / others)
- Persistence
- Humour
- Objectivity
- Patience
- Empathy
- Sensitivity
- Compassion
- Asking for Help
- Medication Adherence
